cues.text: Welcome to the Athar Open Agentic Pact, a community proposal from ODA and AIREV.
This guided narration walks you through the pact, its community model, six pillars, governance, impact tiers, and the Athar OS roadmap.
Use the arrows to move at your own pace.
Section one, the Pact.
The Athar Open Agentic Pact is an open commitment between institutions, partners and platforms to learn, build and deploy agentic AI for public benefit.
It is a community proposal from ODA and AI Rev, designed as a community, not a product.
Signatories agree on shared standards, an open plugin approach and measurable real-world outcomes.
Section two, the Community Model.
Every webinar, chapter event and challenge should lead somewhere real, so the model is built around four outcomes for every participant.

Learn agentic AI, build a useful agent through the Builder Journey and Marketplace, deploy it through a named Accountable Institution, and measure a real-world benefit with baseline evidence of time saved, better service, or wider reach.
Section three, six pillars.
Plugins are the connective tissue: one shared plugin standard, so every integration works everywhere.
Reusable skills are built once and shared across the community.
Universal API licences are managed by Athar, giving members access without duplicated procurement.
Section four, Pledge and Signing.
Joining the Pact is a simple public commitment.
A signatory chooses its roles, sign, govern, build or learn, and pledges to contribute to at least one of the four participant outcomes.
Signing brings access to the learning pathway, the builder journey, and the plugin standard, together with a commitment to report outcomes through the shared impact tiers.

Section five, Actors and Roles, institutions, partners and platforms building the Athar ecosystem together, ODA and AIREV sign and govern, with AIREV, OnDemand, e& and ai& and Discord building, UNDP, UNICEF, IFRC, WFP and UNHCR sign and learn.
The UAE Ministry of Foreign Trade signs and governs and the United Arab Emirates governs.
Every actor has a clear role, sign, govern, build or learn.
Section six, governance and roadmap.
An open steering council sets the shared plugin standard and approves the roadmap.
Decisions, releases, and outcome reports are published, so every member can see how priorities are set and how the platform evolves over time.
Section seven, Impact and Funding.
Three impact tiers, one delivery model, access, ownership, legacy.
A funder can enter at any tier and climb.
Every agreement includes named cohorts and activation targets, independent evaluator baselines, quarterly outcome reports, and open book costs with unspent funds returned.
Universal API licenses, marketplace revenue share and sovereign pilot options fund the model so each partner can choose what fits.
Section eight, Athar OS.
The roadmap runs now in Q4, 2026, next in 2027 and later in 2028.
Nations empowered.
Lebanon, Access, 1 million Lebanese AI experts at $10 million.
India, ownership, 100 government schools and 10,000 AI PCs at 13.7 million.
Kenya, Legacy, a Kenyan-owned sovereign node at around 33 million transferred to a national entity after five to seven years.
Join the Pact.
You have seen the agreement, the community model, the six pillars, the actors, the roadmap, the impact tiers and Athar OS.
Now the invitation is yours.
Choose your role, sign, govern, build or learn.
Commit to one real outcome.
The founding cohort starts this quarter.
Open the pledge, add your name and help us build a Gentick AI that leaves a lasting trace.
Join us.
